topic: Record a 60-second demo video of your project: a 4-part script, free tools, and where to put it
save_reason: A 60-second demo script (what to show in each part) plus a before-you-post checklist, on the cheat sheet and in full in the caption.
send_reason: Send this to a friend whose project only runs on their laptop.

cover.concept: Retro tech still life: a vintage 90s camcorder on a small tripod pointed at a beige retro computer whose screen glows soft blank light, on a warm grey seamless backdrop.
hooks: Show your project in a 60-second demo. (ambition)
Seniors show their projects with a one-minute video. (curiosity, insider)
Record your first project demo tonight. (confidence)
A first-year project can look this good on video. (awe)
Your demo can be shorter than this caption. (wit)

cover.lineDraft: Make one for each project in first year.

slides.label: Why a demo
slides.idea: Not A or B, it's C: it's not your code or your slides, it's a short demo people can watch without installing anything.
slides.title: It's not your code or your slides.
slides.line: It's a short demo people can watch without installing anything.

slides.label: The script
slides.idea: Plan 4 parts before recording: the problem (10s), the app working (30s), one hard part (15s), the link (5s).
slides.title: Write a 4-part script before you record.
slides.line: Problem, the app working, one hard part, then the link.
slides.screen: A notes app page 'Demo script' with 4 timed rows: 0:00 Problem, 0:10 Show it working, 0:40 One hard part, 0:55 Link

slides.label: Better way
slides.idea: Re-hook: you don't need a camera or editing software; your laptop's screen recorder and earphones are enough.
slides.title: Here's a faster way: use your laptop's screen recorder.
slides.line: Your earphones' mic is enough for clear sound.

slides.label: The hard part
slides.idea: Show one hard part and say how you tested it; this is what makes people remember the project.
slides.title: Spend 15 seconds on the hardest part.
slides.line: Say what broke and how you tested the fix.
slides.screen: A video player timeline with chapter markers (Problem, Demo, Hard part, Link), the 'Hard part' chapter highlighted (.focus), a code frame paused on screen

slides.label: Screenshot this
slides.idea: Won't work unless + cheat sheet: the link must open; checklist before posting.
slides.title: This won't work unless the live link opens.
slides.line: Check this list before you post the demo.
slides.screen: A notes checklist 'Before you post': Under 60 seconds; Problem in the first 10 seconds; Live link opens; Repo link with run steps; Captions on; Pinned on GitHub README and LinkedIn
slides.copy_text:
60-second demo script
0:00 The problem your app solves
0:10 The app working, one real task start to finish
0:40 The hardest part and how you tested it
0:55 The live link and repo

Before you post
Under 60 seconds
Problem in the first 10 seconds
Live link opens on a phone
Repo has run steps
Captions on
Video at the top of your README
